proposal.note: Extracted method delta must be <=1500 counted tokens (the M_method cap the solving envelope assumes) or the proposal is rejected with no replacement.

pricing_usd_per_1m.long_context_note: Long-context tier (2x input / 1.5x output) is unreachable by construction: maximum envelope input is 7,000 tokens. Threshold value not needed.
pricing_usd_per_1m.promo_note: Promotional pricing confirmed available at least through 2026-11-21

provider.note: Earlier tables are superseded by this file. Model confirmed present in the account's /v1/models list.

request_parameters.client_request_id_header: X-Client-Request-Id set per invocation (UUID) for timeout forensics
request_parameters.instructions: per-envelope system text; no previous_response_id (stateless); no prompt_cache_key (no cache assumptions in reservations)
request_parameters.max_output_tokens: per-envelope (see envelopes); caps visible output tokens AND reasoning tokens together per API reference
request_parameters.reasoning_note: medium is the documented provider default for GPT-5.6; pinned explicitly rather than omitted
request_parameters.temperature_note: Non-default temperature rejected with HTTP 400 by gpt-5.6-sol; verified empirically 2026-09-16. Corrected from the earlier 0.2 entry, which was never valid for this model. Identical (omitted) across all arms.

settlement_formula_usd: ((input_tokens - cached_tokens - cache_write_tokens) * 4.00 + cached_tokens * 0.40 + cache_write_tokens * 5.00 + output_tokens * 20.00) / 1e6, where output_tokens includes reasoning_tokens per API reference

spend_policy.billing_visibility: Billing endpoints (credit_grants/subscription/usage) require a session key; the API secret key returns 403. Last confirmed balance $104.98 on 2026-09-14 (screenshot). Enforcement is local: reservations gate every call; the ledger in runs/ is the spend record.

tokenizer.note: The provider's own tokenizer library resolves this model to o200k_base. All structural caps are counted with it. Provider usage.input_tokens is settlement truth; any local/provider mismatch beyond 2% on calibration aborts the study.

verified_against: empirical: POST /v1/responses with gpt-5.6-sol, temperature omitted -> 200; temperature 0.2 -> HTTP 400 (2026-09-16)
